Krea2Bausteine.description: Picks two persons, a scene and a style from the saved blocks. New entries appear only after a refresh (R).

Krea2ExpressionBuilder.description: Composes a facial expression. Wire the output into the 'expression' input of Photoshoot Build Prompt and place it with {expression} in the text — as far forward as possible.

Krea2LichtLoad.description: Outputs the text of a saved block.

Krea2LichtSave.description: Stores the text under a name. Flip the switch to 'save', run once, then switch it back. New names appear in the loading node only after a refresh (R).

Krea2LightingBuilder.description: Composes a photographic studio or ambient lighting setup. Wire the output into the 'lighting' input of Photoshoot Build Prompt and place it with {lighting} in the text.

Krea2Monochrome.description: Makes the image truly black and white. The prompt delivers the look, but lipstick keeps a trace of colour - wire this between VAE Decode and Save Image and the trace is gone. Neutral, sepia or cool tint.

Krea2PersonBuilder.description: Builds the person as English text. 'person' is always the full description; 'person_data' is the raw values as JSON for the Photoshoot, which shortens them per camera framing.

Krea2PersonLoad.description: Outputs the text of a saved block.

Krea2PersonSave.description: Stores the text under a name. Flip the switch to 'save', run once, then switch it back. New names appear in the loading node only after a refresh (R).

Krea2Photoshooting.description: Varies camera, pose, expression and aspect ratio across a whole series. The person is optional via 'person_data' and gets shortened per framing. 'person_data' and 'camera_label' at the end are for optional extension packs. 'photo' is the photo number within the series, not a source of randomness - the noise seed comes out of 'image_seed'.

Krea2PoseBuilder.description: Composes a body pose. Wire the output into the 'pose' input of Photoshoot Build Prompt and place it with {pose} in the text — as far forward as possible.

Krea2PromptJoin.description: Replaces {person1} {person2} {person3} {camera} {pose} {expression} {lighting} {scene} {style} {extra}. Recommended: {style}, {camera}, {scene}, {lighting}, {person}, {pose}, {extra}, {expression}. The German spellings still work. {extra} is for extension packs. Without placeholders: style first, then camera, scene and lighting before the person.

Krea2PromptLoad.description: Outputs the text of a saved block.

Krea2PromptSave.description: Stores the text under a name. Flip the switch to 'save', run once, then switch it back. New names appear in the loading node only after a refresh (R).

Krea2StilLoad.description: Outputs the text of a saved block.

Krea2StilSave.description: Stores the text under a name. Flip the switch to 'save', run once, then switch it back. New names appear in the loading node only after a refresh (R).

Krea2StyleBuilder.description: Composes the photographic look: colour or black and white, film stock, genre, lens, finish. Wire the output into the 'style' input of Photoshoot Build Prompt and place it with {style} in the text.

Krea2SzeneLoad.description: Outputs the text of a saved block.

Krea2SzeneSave.description: Stores the text under a name. Flip the switch to 'save', run once, then switch it back. New names appear in the loading node only after a refresh (R).
